newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda stops production of landmines and grenades.
newsitem.headline: Uganda stops production of landmines and grenades.

text.p: Uganda has stopped producing landmines and grenades at its Chinese-built arms factory in response to international calls for a worldwide ban, the state-owned Sunday Vision reported on Sunday.

Major Fred Mwesigye, managing the factory which supplies the Uganda army but does not export its products, was quoted as saying: "We have received many calls for such a ban. It has been decided to close the section down."
Instead of landmines and grenades, the factory will turn out dry-cell batteries after new equipment is obtained for the change-over, he said.
Although the factory, commissioned five years ago, had capacity to produce 50,000 mines a year, only 10,000 had been made, and these were still unused.
